sudo sh -c 'nohup python2 /tmp/listen.py 23 > /tmp/l23.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/l23.pid'
sleep 1
sudo netstat -tlnp 2>&1 | grep -E ':8080|:23 '

python2 -c "
import socket
for p in (8080,23):
    s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(3)
    try:
        s.connect(('192.168.2.2', p))
        print p, 'CONNECTED', s.recv(100)
    except Exception as e:
        print p, 'FAILED', e
    s.close()
"
commands.stdout:
8080 CONNECTED hello from node3 port 8080

23 FAILED [Errno 111] Connection refused
